tasks.description: Implement test validity classification in build-implement.js workflow. Add testValidity pure function to sentinel block; integrate detector agent that runs when tests fail; route test_defect tests away from correctness lens; add behaviour_changed field to ChangeSet and test_validity array to EvidenceBundle in schema; refuse fixes with behaviour_changed:false that cite test failures; update fixer and test-author prompts with new rules and behaviors; add tests verifying testValidity logic, detector integration, fix refusal, and output schema.
